source: Merged by the agent from the product owner's modelle-5 Meshy AI models (GitHub release draft modelle-5, Oct 2026): the stylized-toon close-up head (Meshy_AI_Stylized_Toon_Male_He_...glb) placed on the headless stylized-toon body (Meshy_AI_Stylized_Toon_Male_Bo_...glb) by tools/meshy/merge4.py v5 (head sized by its neck and 12 % larger for the mobile-game look, eyes set back and the under-eye bags smoothed, eye size and lip/jaw proportions half-way toward the PO's photos, body skin matched to the face, one closed surface, face-first UVs, colours and normals baked from the sources); under-eye colour retouched by tools/meshy/faceretouch.py --underlid. Game copy reduced by tools/meshy/reduce.py, rigged by tools/meshy/skin.py, blink morph by tools/meshy/blink.py. The modelle-4 cartoon is in git history before S18.
